newsitem.title: USA: Pentagon says it has no report Iraq fired missiles.
newsitem.headline: Pentagon says it has no report Iraq fired missiles.

text.p: The Pentagon said it had no reports from its forces in the field that Iraq had fired missiles at U.S. and allied warplanes patrolling a no-fly zone over southern Iraq on Thursday.

"We have no reports of any missile firings," said Navy Commander Joe March, a Pentagon spokesman, after Iraqi state television quoted a military spokesman in Baghdad as saying three surface-to-air missiles had been fired at "hostile targets," forcing them to flee.
